name: Chat with a Google Sheet using AI
description: Allows users to interact with and query data within a Google Sheet using natural language via an AI model, making data analysis more accessible.

source.path: Google_Drive_and_Google_Sheets/Chat with a Google Sheet using AI.json

setup: "Chat Trigger" (chatTrigger) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.
"Execute Workflow Trigger" (executeWorkflowTrigger) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.
Setup value spreadsheetId: Google Sheets spreadsheet id (for example 1AbC...xyz). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.

hints: The original was a sub-workflow called by another workflow; pass its inputs as run inputs.
Provide `chatInput` (and optionally `sessionId`) as run inputs; the original started from a chat message.

"AI Agent" used agent tools in the original: Get customer tool (toolWorkflow), List columns tool (toolWorkflow), Get column values tool (toolWorkflow). The cdecli agent calls connectors directly; connect credentials for the services those tools reached.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
### Sub-workflow: Custom tool
This can be called by the agent above. It returns three different types of data from the Google Sheet, which can be used together for more complex queries without returning the whole sheet (which might be too big for GPT to handle)
### Main workflow: AI agent using custom tool
